PROCEDURE CODE
1287
Divorce by mutual consent
The spouses who are determined to effect a divorce by mutual consent are bound to settle beforehand their respective rights, on which they are free to compromise.
They may have an inventory drawn up beforehand.
They must record in the same instrument their agreements concerning the exercise of the rights provided for in Articles [5 4.17, 4.18, paragraphs 1 and 2, 4.20 and 4.147]5 of the Civil Code in the event that one of them dies before the judgment or decree granting the divorce has become res judicata.
A literal extract of the deed recording these agreements must be transcribed, insofar as it relates to immovable property, at the competent office of the General Administration of Property Documentation in whose jurisdiction the property is located, in the manner and within the time limits provided for in Article 4 3.31 of the Civil Code.
